In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?

WITH team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        home_team AS team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
    FROM match_view
    GROUP BY league, home_team
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        league,
        away_team AS team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
    FROM match_view
    GROUP BY league, away_team
),
team_wins_combined AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team,
        SUM(wins) AS total_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY league, team
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        league,
        team,
        total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY league ORDER BY total_wins ASC, team ASC) AS rn
    FROM team_wins_combined
)
SELECT league, team, total_wins
FROM ranked_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league

WITH wins AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id as league_id,
        l.name as league_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN m.home_team_api_id
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN m.away_team_api_id
            ELSE NULL
        END as winner_team_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        league_name,
        winner_team_id,
        COUNT(*) as win_count
    FROM wins
    WHERE winner_team_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY league_id, league_name, winner_team_id
),
min_wins AS (
    SELECT league_id, MIN(win_count) as min_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY league_id
),
result AS (
    SELECT 
        lw.league_id,
        lw.league_name,
        lw.winner_team_id,
        lw.win_count
    FROM team_wins lw
    JOIN min_wins mw ON lw.league_id = mw.league_id
    WHERE lw.win_count = mw.min_wins
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lw.league_id ORDER BY lw.league_id, lw.winner_team_id) = 1
)
SELECT 
    r.league_name,
    t.team_long_name as team_name,
    r.win_count
FROM result r
JOIN Team t ON r.winner_team_id = t.team_api_id
ORDER BY r.league_id
